pr.title: feat(governance): W02 derived DispatchQualification join
pr.body:
## Summary
- W02 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001, stacked on W01
- pure derived join over seven receipt dicts -> DISPATCHABLE | BLOCKED | NEEDS_SUPERVISOR
- negative tests: missing receipt fails closed, DCP denial cannot be widened, TO illegality cannot be overridden, operator gate cannot self-authorize, binding is not authorization

## Authority
Result carries authority NONE. No dispatch, merge or activation behaviour.

MERGE_AUTHORIZED=NO ACTIVATION_AUTHORIZED=NO

steps.task: Identity and base preflight; no edits until it passes.
requirements: Worktree /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/.worktrees/gec-v2-w02, branch feat/gec-v2-w02-dispatch-qualification-001, 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 is an ancestor of HEAD, clean tree except this packet.
Confirm tests/governance/governed_execution passes at base (91) and kit tests pass (43).

Frozen dataclasses: ReceiptInput(name: Literal of the seven names, payload: Mapping | None), Provenance(verified_by, verified_at, schema_set_digest), JoinInput(receipts: Mapping[name, payload|None], provenance).

Per-receipt extractors that read ONLY these fields from the payload dict, treating any missing/None/unknown value as DENY-or-UNKNOWN per the table: ScopeAuthority: {scope_status: PASS|BLOCKED|UNKNOWN, allowlist_digest}; WorkflowLegality: {transition_legal: bool|None, blockers: list}; PolicyEligibility: {dcp_status: PASS|BLOCKED|UNKNOWN|NOT_RUN}; CanonicalWriter: {custody_state: HELD|RELEASED|AMBIGUOUS}; ExecutionBinding: {authority: must equal 'NONE', selection.runner_availability: PROVEN|PROPOSED|UNKNOWN}; OperatorGate: {required: bool, receipt_ref: str|None, granted: bool|None}; DriftOverlap: {drift_class: enums drift_class}.
Extractors never raise on malformed input; they return a structured Finding(receipt, field, observed, effect) where effect is DENY|UNKNOWN|OK.
validation: ruff clean; module imports without side effects.

requirements: qualify(inp: JoinInput) -> DispatchQualification(result: str, reasons: tuple[Finding,...], authority: 'NONE', is_execution_authority: False, provenance).

Rules, in this fixed precedence: (1) any mandatory receipt absent -> BLOCKED [all seven are mandatory]; (2) ExecutionBinding.authority != 'NONE' -> BLOCKED (a binding claiming authority is malformed); (3) PolicyEligibility.dcp_status BLOCKED -> BLOCKED; (4) WorkflowLegality.transition_legal False -> BLOCKED; (5) OperatorGate.required True and granted is not True -> BLOCKED; (6) CanonicalWriter.custody_state AMBIGUOUS or RELEASED -> BLOCKED; (7) DriftOverlap.drift_class CONFLICTING -> BLOCKED; (8) ScopeAuthority.scope_status BLOCKED -> BLOCKED; (9) any UNKNOWN or NOT_RUN or SUPERSET among the above, or runner_availability != PROVEN -> NEEDS_SUPERVISOR; (10) otherwise DISPATCHABLE.

No rule may upgrade a result: the evaluation is a fold from DISPATCHABLE downward; once BLOCKED, later receipts cannot lift it. Assert this by construction (max over an ordering BLOCKED > NEEDS_SUPERVISOR > DISPATCHABLE).
reasons is deterministic: sorted by (rule number, receipt name).
test_join_positive: a full seven-receipt DISPATCHABLE fixture; the same with drift_class SUBSET/COMPATIBLE/IDENTICAL still DISPATCHABLE.

test_join_negative, one test per MACRO proof obligation, each asserting result AND the reason's rule number: each of the seven receipts absent -> BLOCKED; dcp_status BLOCKED with every other receipt perfect -> BLOCKED (denial cannot be widened); transition_legal False with every other receipt perfect -> BLOCKED; operator gate required and granted None/False, even with receipt_ref present -> BLOCKED (cannot self-authorize); ExecutionBinding.authority 'GRANTED' -> BLOCKED (binding is not authorization); custody AMBIGUOUS -> BLOCKED; drift CONFLICTING -> BLOCKED; dcp_status UNKNOWN -> NEEDS_SUPERVISOR; runner_availability PROPOSED -> NEEDS_SUPERVISOR; drift SUPERSET -> NEEDS_SUPERVISOR; a malformed payload (string instead of dict) -> BLOCKED without raising.

test_purity_and_enum: calling qualify twice with the same input yields equal results; the module performs no filesystem or subprocess access (monkeypatch builtins.open and subprocess.run to raise, then call qualify); the three result values equal enums.v1.schema.json definitions/dispatch_qualification/enum exactly; result.authority == 'NONE' and result.is_execution_authority is False for every fixture.
Run every commit.verify line; all exit 0. Commit per slice (S1, S2, S3) with the packet message prefix and the Co-Authored-By trailer. No push.
